name: фонокорректор Amazon Audio B-Lab ( amazon audio b lab )
descriptionHtml:
B-Lab Amazon Audio B Lab
High End фоно корректор. Dimensions: 300 x 350 x 75 mm (W x
L x H);
Amazon Audio B Lab Weight: 12kg; Cabinet: massive aluminum;
Superior high selected electronic parts; Automatic impedance
adjustment; The B-lab Phonoamplifier is provided with a
worldwide unique impedance matching circuit. That means
this phonoamplifier finds the perfect terminating impedance
by itself.
You don’t have to give thoughts to the right
impedance – the B-lab Phonoamplifier always adjust the ideal
value. Gain adjustment in 12 steps; Balanced input circuit;
Class A – single ended design; 99,999% pure copper gold
plated sockets (without nickel); 99,999% pure silver wiring
with cotton dielectric; Custom-made insulation feet
